name: INDITEX INH.  EO 0,03
summary: Industria de Diseño Textil, S.A. (Inditex) is a Spanish multinational clothing company and retailer, known for its fast-fashion business model. The company owns brands such as Zara, Massimo Dutti, Pull&Bear, Bershka, Stradivarius, Oysho, and Uterqüe. Inditex is headquartered in Arteixo, Spain.
